name: soulsteel
protection_note: Spirit-forged steel, the plan's silver mail: what would drink your life finds a soul already bound in the metal.
lore_descriptor: gray steel that hums faintly, quenched with a name spoken over it
first_pickup_chronicle: Soulsteel. A name was spoken into the quench and the metal still remembers it. The ghosts here look at me differently now. I hope it is respect.
